title: How the education classifier answers, abstains and retrains
desc: Unlabelled education records from university, K-12 and international taxonomies go to domain-specialised models that were fine-tuned task-adaptively and ship through CI/CD. Each model answers only the records it is confident about and holds the rest back. A drift monitor watches the incoming records and triggers retraining.
caption: Selective prediction: the models answer what they are sure of and hold back the rest.
